decision: Capital allocation between Sea Limited (SE) and Nu Holdings (NU) as plays on the emerging-market Engel transition
method: Weighted sum (Belton & Stewart 2002), direct weights, lisp_eval helpers from the mcda skill

criteria.name: Profitability
criteria.metric: NU pre-tax margin (EBT/revenue); SE GAAP operating margin

criteria.name: Growth
criteria.metric: YoY revenue growth; NU FX-neutral 39%, SE USD 48.1%

criteria.name: Engel headroom
criteria.metric: Average predicted food share of core markets (SE: IDN, VNM, PHL, BRA; NU: BRA, MEX, COL)

compensation_masking.SE: Profitability 0.28 < 0.30 danger threshold on a 30% weight

variant_usd_growth_for_NU.note: Using NU USD-reported growth (55.8%) instead of FX-neutral flips the ranking to NU

caveats: NU and Monee credit books are not like-for-like (NU: credit cards and unsecured loans; Monee: Shopee-linked consumer and SME credit).
Pre-tax margin (NU) vs operating margin (SE) are different P&L lines.
Score scales and weights are analyst judgments; the min_flip result shows the ranking depends on them.
supersedes: MCDA of 2026-10-22 (SE 0.84 vs NU 0.78, robust) built on recalled FY2024 inputs; criteria and weights of that run were not recorded.
